items.title: Let a human clear a freeze on a story whose lease is stale with one story_resume command
items.context: The two gates are each correct alone and deadlock together. Either story_resume takes over a STALE lease implicitly (never an active one), or the breaker gate exempts story_resume from the takeover-carrying block while keeping it for every other command. Do not weaken the block for story_advance or for any other takeover command.

items.title: Regression: freeze a story, expire its lease, prove one story_resume from a new session clears it
items.context: Hermetic fixture. Also prove the two failure modes it replaces: a takeover-carrying non-resume command is still blocked while frozen, and an ACTIVE lease is still not seized by story_resume.
